name: chlaude-gptopus-desktop
description: Eight OpenAI workers with separate API keys, durable accounting and opt-in ULTRA governed swarms. Think-only by default; explicit project scopes enable reads and private staged patches.
long_description: Eight OpenAI workers with standard/free key separation and shared durable usage estimates. Existing think-only delegation remains the default. Opt-in ULTRA adds recursive recruitment, protected review capacity and approval gates. Chat profile B reads owner-selected source roots; separately enabled C creates private staged patches. No general shell or live-project patch executor is supplied. Install and qualify the native plugin separately for supported local Code sessions.

ultra_config_path.title: ULTRA owner policy file (optional)
ultra_config_path.description: Absolute path to a policy created with the local ULTRA configuration command. Leave blank to use the shared default location. ULTRA remains disabled until the policy enables it.

allow_ultra_api.title: Allow governed ULTRA API requests
allow_ultra_api.description: After offline acceptance, authorise ULTRA model requests within your configured policy and budgets. This may spend API credits. Does not approve files, commands, deployments or merges.

straight_api_key.title: Straight OpenAI API key
straight_api_key.description: Used by sol, astra, luna and sol6-1flex. Leave empty on Windows to reuse the key saved by Chlaude-GPTopus CLI setup, if available.

free_api_key.title: Free-programme OpenAI API key
free_api_key.description: Used only by astra6free and terra5-6free. Leave empty on Windows to reuse the existing DPAPI free key, if available.
